context_policy: Use context_bbox exactly as supplied for all 126 records. Do not narrow it from target_bbox width: field headings must remain fully visible.
multi_target_policy: When target_bboxes exists, draw only those boxes. target_bbox is their union for context selection, not an additional rectangle.
